source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.9 with Fig. 6.10 and Example 6.4 (PDF 132-133).

blocks.text: Refrigerator aisa device hai jo kisi cheez ka temperature us ke surroundings (aas paas ki cheezein) se kam rakhta hai. Yeh bhi cyclic process mein chalta hai, magar heat engine ke ulat, jaisa Fig. 6.10 mein hai. Refrigerator thande reservoir se heat leta hai aur garam reservoir ko de deta hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke refrigerator mein system par work kiya jata hai, jab ke heat engine mein system khud work karta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar laal patti Higher temperature surroundings aur neeche narangi patti Low temperature compartment, darmiyan surmai patti surmai circle (gol chakkar) Refrigerator se guzarti hai. Circle ke neeche oopar ka teer QC, Heat in; oopar oopar ka teer QH, Heat out. Daen taraf se work ka teer refrigerator mein: W.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.10: Refrigerator bahar ke work ki madad se kam temperature wale khane se heat le kar zyada temperature wale surroundings ko deta hai; yeh ulta chalta heat engine hai (kitab ki Figure 6.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Refrigerator thermodynamics ke doosre law ke Clausius statement par chalta hai, yani yeh ulta chalne wala heat engine hai. Compressor Low Temperature Reservoir (LTR, thanda hissa) se heat Q_C kheenchta hai aur bahar se kiye gaye work ki madad se use High Temperature Reservoir (HTR, garam surroundings) mein phenk deta hai. HTR ko di gayi heat Q_H yeh hai:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Heat khud thandi jagah se garam jagah nahi jati. Refrigerator par work W kiya jata hai; woh thande khane se Q_C leta hai aur surroundings ko Q_H = Q_C + W deta hai. Yeh heat engine (Figure 6.8) ka ulta hai.

blocks.latex: Q_C + W = Q_H \qquad \text{or} \qquad W = Q_H - Q_C
blocks.text_alt: Q_C + W = Q_H   ya   W = Q_H − Q_C

blocks.text: Refrigerator ka asal purpose (maqsad) yeh hai ke kam se kam work W kharch kar ke LTR se zyada se zyada heat Q_C nikali jaye.
